<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has confirmed that the meeting has been booked for Wednesday at 3:00 PM.
My next and final task is to send the confirmation email to the partners.
I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function to do this.
The details for the email are:
- Day: Wednesday
- Start time: 15:00 (3:00 PM)
- Body: I'll write a simple confirmation message.
After sending the email, the task will be complete.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments: {"start":"15:00","body":"This is a confirmation that the partners' meeting has been scheduled for this coming Wednesday, November 18 at 3:00 PM Eastern.","day":"Wed"}
